title: Peak Palosseum text tweaks
summary: This version only reworded two Peak Palosseum messages: the tier-promotion confirmation now says entering the higher tier resets your points and rank, and the round-result mail no longer repeats the round number. No palmons, skills, items or systems changed.
highlights: Tier-up prompt reworded: "Advancing to the higher tier Palosseum" is now "Entering the higher tier Palosseum"; it still warns that points and rank reset.
Peak Palosseum result mail simplified: the "(X)" round marker is dropped and the sentence reads as one line congratulating your rank.
